pages.text:
This Lease commences on September 1, 2023 and expires on August 31, 2028.
Base Rent shall be $7,000.00 per month for the first two years, increasing by ten percent (10%) at the
start of the third year of the Term only, with no further increases thereafter.

notes: A one-time 10% bump is NOT the same as an annual/anniversary escalation -- field_extractor's suffix logic only attaches 'annually' when the text says 'annual'/'anniversary'/'each year'/'per year', none of which appear here, so parse_percent's caller in obligations.py correctly finds no annual cue and returns no trigger dates rather than guessing this is recurring.
